primitives.note: Biggest Snowball Ever! channels up to 10s (explosion damage capping at 5s) and Absolute Zero channels up to 3s; both block other actions while running except for one exempted spell slot per the wiki's channel-interaction table.

W has a manual/automatic recast that releases the snowball; E can be recast up to twice within 3s for extra volleys plus a delayed Snowbound root-damage tick; R has a manual/automatic recast that detonates the blizzard.

Call of the Freljord grants Nunu 20% bonus attack speed and 10% bonus movement speed for 4s (extendable) on landing damage against the dummy; per-target retrigger is limited to once per 10s (ontargetcdstatic), so uptime in a solo-dummy fight is intermittent, not constant.
Consume is a short-cast (0.3s), low-cooldown single-target bite dealing champion-branch magic damage (since the dummy counts as an enemy champion) plus a self-heal.

Mana costs (Q 60, W/E 50-70 by rank, R 100 flat) stack up fast in a 15s window; R alone is a third of a typical early-mid-game mana pool, so mana may cap how much of the kit can be cast rather than cooldowns alone.

needsBespoke.why: The kit's mechanics (channel-and-recast W/R, multi-recast E, an intermittent on-damage self-buff, a plain single-target bite, and mana as a real constraint) map onto existing primitives. Optimal play always fully charges W/R for maximum damage, so the continuous charge-time ramp only needs to be evaluated at its capped/maximum value, not modeled as a separate scaling primitive. The passive's cleave to secondary targets never triggers in a one-target dummy fight (no secondary target exists), so it is omitted rather than bespoke-modeled.
